reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing shared getScheduledAmount that the server and client sites already call, but leaves the preview in computeSchedulePreviewTransactions (whose comment it edits) and schedule-template.ts on their own midpoint arithmetic instead of routing them through it.

duplication.why: The diff adds no new copies, but it leaves the two pre-existing inline range computations in place next to the helper it changes.

placement.why: The rule change is made in shared/schedules.ts, the module that owns the expected-amount helper.

scope.why: Only the helper, its tests and the related comments are touched.

maintainability.why: One-line change in the shared helper is easy to own, but the edited comment in computeSchedulePreviewTransactions now claims 'lowest allowed amount' over code that still computes the midpoint, which misleads the next maintainer.
